After four-goal European displays in midweek, Napoli and Roma turn their focus back to Serie A, where the visitors are pushing for top spot, while the hosts are aiming to close the gap on their opponents here.

## Match News and Current Form [...] Roma ended a two-match draw streak in Serie A with a 2-0 victory over Genoa last Saturday to stay within two points of the summit. They carried that momentum into midweek, thrashing Slovan Bratislava 4-0, while they have earned 17 points from their first seven league outings this season (W5, D2) - their best return at this stage since 2014/15. Defensive solidity away from home has been central to that success, as the Giallorossi have kept a clean sheet in all three top-flight games on the road
